mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_deploy_window WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND ( (window_type = 'DAILY' AND TIME(#{checkTime}) BETWEEN start_time AND end_time) OR (window_type = 'WEEKLY' AND FIND_IN_SET(DAYOFWEEK(#{checkTime}), week_days) > 0 AND TIME(#{checkTime}) BETWEEN start_time AND end_time) OR (window_type = 'MONTHLY' AND FIND_IN_SET(DAY(#{checkTime}), month_days) > 0 AND TIME(#{checkTime}) BETWEEN start_time AND end_time) )
SELECT * FROM wf_deploy_window WHERE is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
